# VEDIXA ERP

> VEDIXA ERP is a cloud-based fertilizer shop management and billing software for fertilizer, seed, and pesticide retail businesses in India.

VEDIXA ERP provides fast GST billing, FIFO & batch-wise inventory tracking, customer ledgers, supplier ledgers, WhatsApp invoice sharing, and real-time business analytics for agro dealers and agricultural retail stores.
